runtime: Actual Lua 5.1 modules with mocked client APIs; no live-game actions

results.name: Weapon submenu drills down, preserves parent until selection, and Reset all clears subtype
Output and quest reward subclasses combine with rarity and reject other types
Trainer Show includes structured catalog and recorded offerings, excludes drops
Vendor Profit prefers higher net returns, Cheapest remains unchanged
Minimal loss and training fees are included in the route score
AH proceeds use auction data, output minimum and selected fee, not reagent overrides
Best method compares net proceeds and never sums both sale destinations
BoP and unknown binding cannot be auctioned; missing sales create an explained gap
Fresh observed AH prices win; stale sources and provider exceptions are handled
Profit menu, goal, cache separation and cost table show the selected method
Shopping preserves profit materials and marks changes of objective or fee stale
Profit scan adds unique outputs while Cheapest retains reagent-only scans
Unavailable recipes, enchants and cooldowns do not become profit candidates
No profitable output is added beyond the skill goal and repeat segments do not farm rounding crafts
